method:
Use the complete prompt with Nano Banana 2, explicitly named in the original post. Keep the dark background free of objects and describe a narrow side beam across eye level. Tilt the head and bring one shoulder forward for depth. A 3:4 frame is a suitable starting option for the retained image, not a verified source setting.

Limitations: The output has partly gathered hair and a shallow-angle beam, not a word-for-word rendition of fully loose long hair and a pronounced diagonal. The author names Nano Banana 2; a secondary Pro label does not establish a different model. The X rendition is 896 × 1200 pixels. Seed, provider, native resolution and camera settings are not evidenced.
